_note: Confirmed fixes to TrackMan tagging. Each fix finds one pitch by batter + game date + PitchNo. "pa": "" removes the plate-appearance result on that pitch (the PA then ends on a later pitch, or not at all); any other value (OUT, 1B, BB...) replaces it.

fixes.note: Strikeout tagged on a 2-0 count; not a strikeout and not a plate appearance
